title: Mixer visibility and components
setup_and_action: Use each admitted view with an independently available mixer; toggle section visibility and separately one actually offered component. Retain view/focus/configuration, using keyboard-navigation for traversal.
source_claim: Mixer controls are available from Session and Arrangement; the bottom-right mixer control shows/hides the section, with its adjacent menu controlling component visibility. Arrangement also offers Track Controls. No geometry, accessibility order or persistence law is supplied.
documentary_expected: Named visible control/state role only: Mixer visibility and components
documentary_comparator: Visible named-role inspection only; no numeric/signal/timing comparator

title: Resizable meter presentation
setup_and_action: Independently admit compact and expanded mixer/track widths, resize and inspect the named controls; separately reset an actually exposed peak indicator after a known positive meter event.
source_claim: Increasing mixer height reveals tick marks, numeric volume and resettable peak-level indicators; increased track width adds a decibel scale. These are presentation roles, with no pixel thresholds, calibrated detector or reset duration.
documentary_expected: Named visible control/state role only: Resizable meter presentation
documentary_comparator: Visible named-role inspection only; no numeric/signal/timing comparator

title: Selected mixer controls move together
setup_and_action: Select two valid tracks with independently admitted distinguishable values and an unselected control track; separately edit volume, pan and Activator on reset copies, inspecting every selected/unselected state. No common numeric delta or boundary law is inferred.
source_claim: With multiple tracks selected, editing one mixer control edits that control for the selected tracks. The source describes preserving existing knob/slider differences; coordinates/units, clamping, boundary interactions and exact transformations remain unknown. Existing mixer values own numeric laws.

title: Pan mode menu and reset gestures
setup_and_action: In each admitted mixer view inspect mode menu and corresponding controls, then separately use double-click and triangle reset after independently accepted nondefault pan values. Record resulting values with no new reset-number or signal comparator.
source_claim: Pan context menu chooses Stereo versus Split Stereo presentation; Split offers independent left/right controls. Double-clicking Pan or clicking its triangle in the Session/Arrangement mixer resets to the described default. Numeric defaults, ramps and stereo processing remain with mixer values.
documentary_expected: Named visible control/state role only: Pan mode menu and reset gestures
documentary_comparator: Visible named-role inspection only; no numeric/signal/timing comparator

title: Exclusive and multiselected Solo controls
setup_and_action: Establish two eligible positive playing tracks plus an unselected control, then separately propose Solo with multi-selection, exclusive preference on/off and platform modifier on/off in admitted focus contexts. Retain actual solo flags and outputs separately; no arbitrary-graph signal oracle.
source_claim: Solo supports selected-track sets. Outside that multi-selection context, ordinary exclusivity is bypassed by Ctrl on Windows/Cmd on Mac or disabled Exclusive Solo preference. S invokes the solo shortcut in an eligible focus context owned by keyboard/remote control. Arbitrary routed graph muting remains separately owned.

source_claim: Adjacent/nonadjacent selection is described with Shift/Ctrl-click. Dragging nonadjacent tracks collapses them together at drop; Ctrl+arrow moves without collapsing. This paragraph does not qualify Ctrl by platform, so no Cmd substitution or complete focus/ordering grammar is inferred.
documentary_expected: Named visible control/state role only: Nonadjacent track move context
